intent: Analyze Thermal Throttling issue in MSI GP66 Leopard Gaming System
suggested_solution: Lower core clock as much as possible (-501 or lower) and use the curve editor to go lower than -501.
Increase memory clock until you get errors then back off a bit so you aren't right on the edge.
Processor power tweak sometimes helps, sometimes doesn't, worth a try.
Don't put Arctic Cool MX-4 in a laptop.
Adjusting the GPU core clock to -300 or -400 can help set the majority of the curve below the target speed, making it easier to adjust the lowest voltage point.
Using the latest version of Afterburner with the curve editor feature can automatically adjust higher voltages to match the desired speed.
